gbm_population_evidence.quote: Hypofractionation Trial of Re-irradiation in Good Prognosis Recurrent Glioblastoma
Histologic diagnosis of primary glioblastoma or gliosarcoma of the brain, or secondary glioblastoma of the brain due to transformation from a lower grade to a grade 4 tumor.

candidate_evidence.quote: Radiation Therapy: Radiation therapy will be administered via a linear accelerator using 6 megavoltage (MV) photons or greater.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Hypofractionation Trial of Re-irradiation in Good Prognosis Recurrent Glioblastoma

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-only dose-escalation trial (re-irradiation); no drug or biologic interventions. Conditions also list astrocytoma/glioma, but inclusion restricts to glioblastoma/gliosarcoma including secondary glioblastoma transformed from lower grade; coded gbm_only with historical terminology because secondary (transformed) glioblastoma, likely IDH-mutant, is explicitly allowed. Gadolinium MRI is routine assessment, not a registered intervention. Two sequential arms (escalation, MTD) with no control.
